## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `develop` and holds one change.
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and the checks in CONTRIBUTING.md pass.
- [ ] A changeset is included if the change touches shipped code.
- [ ] Docs are updated where behaviour changed.
- [ ] No generated files, screenshots, videos, logs or private data are committed.
